bib.title: Feature Pyramid Networks for Object Detection

question: Can a ConvNet's own multi-scale pyramidal feature hierarchy be turned into a feature pyramid that is semantically strong at every scale, replacing featurized image pyramids at marginal extra cost?
hypothesis: Combining low-resolution semantically strong features with high-resolution semantically weak features via a top-down pathway and lateral connections gives strong semantics at all levels and improves multi-scale detection, especially of small objects.
contributions: FPN: top-down pathway with lateral connections builds a feature pyramid with rich semantics at all levels from a single input scale
Applied to RPN and Fast/Faster R-CNN with minimal changes, giving state-of-the-art single-model COCO results
Extension to mask proposals (DeepMask/SharpMask style) that beats image-pyramid methods in AR and speed

method.summary: A backbone ResNet's last-block outputs C2-C5 (strides 4,8,16,32) are combined with a top-down path (2x nearest-neighbour upsampling + 1x1 lateral conv + element-wise add, then 3x3 conv) into P2-P5 (plus P6 by stride-2 subsampling for RPN), all with 256 channels. Shared-weight heads are attached to every level in RPN and Fast R-CNN; RoIs are assigned to levels by k=floor(k0+log2(sqrt(wh)/224)), k0=4.
method.task: object detection, box proposals and instance-segment proposals on COCO

datasets.name: COCO detection (80 categories)
datasets.size: 80k train + 35k val subset (trainval35k) for training; 5k val (minival) for ablations
datasets.split: train trainval35k; ablate on minival; final on test-std/test-dev (no disclosed labels)
datasets.preprocessing: shorter image side resized to 800 px (single scale, no scale jitter in mask experiment)

datasets.name: ImageNet1k classification
datasets.preprocessing: backbones pre-trained, then fine-tuned on COCO

datasets.name: COCO train / first 5k val images (mask proposals)
datasets.size: first 5k COCO val images for evaluation
datasets.split: train on train set, evaluate on first 5k val

models.name: FPN + ResNet-50/101 (RPN, Fast R-CNN, Faster R-CNN)
models.architecture: ResNet backbone, FPN d=256, no non-linearities in extra layers; RPN head 3x3 conv + two sibling 1x1 convs; Fast R-CNN head RoI pool 7x7 + two 1,024-d fc (ReLU) + cls/box layers
models.init_from: ImageNet1k pre-trained ResNet-50/101; fc head layers randomly initialised

other.anchor_labels: positive: highest IoU for a GT box or IoU>0.7; negative: IoU<0.3
other.roi_train_test: 2000 RoIs per image for training, 1000 for testing

models.name: FPN mask proposal model
models.architecture: FPN P2-P6 with d=128; 5x5 MLP (5x5 kernel, 512 outputs, sibling fc to 14x14 mask + 1 score) plus 7x7 MLP for half octaves

models.name: Single-scale baselines (C4 conv5-head, C5 2fc-head)
models.architecture: Faster R-CNN/RPN on a single feature map

training.objective: RPN: object/non-object classification + box regression; Fast R-CNN: classification + box regression; masks: mask loss weighted 10x over score loss
training.lr_schedule: RPN: 0.02 for first 30k mini-batches then 0.002 for next 10k; Fast R-CNN: 0.02 for first 60k then 0.002 for next 20k; masks: 0.03 for 80k, divided by 10 after 60k; ResNet-101 leaderboard model: 2x mini-batches at each lr
training.batch_size: 8 GPUs x 2 images; RPN 256 anchors/image; Fast R-CNN 512 RoIs/image; masks 2048 examples (128 x 16 images), pos:neg 1:3
training.hardware: 8 GPUs (synchronized SGD); inference timed on one NVIDIA M40
training.wall_clock: RPN with FPN about 8 hours on COCO; Fast R-CNN with FPN about 10 hours on COCO (8 GPUs); feature sharing raises train time 1.5x

other.rpn_anchors: anchors outside the image included in training for all RPN experiments, unlike Faster R-CNN
other.sharing_heads: head parameters shared across levels; unshared evaluated with similar accuracy

inference.samples: single input scale, single model; no seeds or repeats reported

parameters.proposals_test: 1000 per image (Faster R-CNN; 300 in He et al.)
parameters.mask_inference: masks at 1000 highest-scoring locations, no NMS or post-processing

metrics.name: AR (AR100, AR1k; ARs/m/l)
metrics.definition: COCO-style Average Recall at 100 or 1000 proposals per image, by object size

metrics.name: AP, AP@0.5, APs/m/l
metrics.definition: COCO-style Average Precision; PASCAL-style AP at single IoU 0.5; by object size

metrics.name: inference time
metrics.definition: seconds per image on one NVIDIA M40

baselines: RPN/Faster R-CNN on C4 (conv5 head) and C5 (2fc head)
He et al. ResNet-50 Faster R-CNN
G-RMI, AttractioNet, Faster R-CNN+++, Multipath, ION
eval.protocol: Ablations on minival with ResNet-50 and shared hyperparameters; final on test-dev/test-std; single run each, no variance reported.

limits: Single run per configuration; no variance, seeds or significance tests reported.
Authors concede ResNet-101 model was not sufficiently trained at default schedule; feature-sharing version of the submitted model not evaluated due to limited time.
Does not use iterative regression, hard negative mining, context modeling or stronger augmentation; stated as complementary, untested.
Only simple connection block tried; multi-layer residual blocks gave marginally better results but were not adopted.
Why the top-down pathway helps is conjectured (semantic gaps), not tested.
The COCO state-of-the-art claims are dated; code release is promised, not given.

terms.definition: A top-down architecture with lateral connections for building high-level semantic feature maps at all scales
Feature pyramids built upon image pyramids; features computed on each image scale independently

lineage.note: RPN and detector adapted with FPN
RoI pooling detector run on pyramid
earlier use of ConvNet feature hierarchy as pyramid
top-down/skip architectures that predict at the finest level only
